description:
HNJT-OL requires the destruction of 8,000 lbs of SAP IT Hardware. Facility must be a Department of the Air Force approved IT sanitation facility

Minimum standards to meet sanitization requirements IAW DAF SAP IT Sanitization Standard Operating Procedure, minimum standards to meet sanitization requirements are:
Incineration: 670 degrees Celsius with two exceptions.
Solid State Drives (SSD): 500 degrees Celsius
Optical storage device: 600 degrees Celsius
Smelting: 1204 degrees Celsius
Disintegration to particles that are nominally 2 millimeters (mm) in size.
